_meta.beachhead: Small B2B SaaS teams (2-20 people) with a self-serve trial/freemium and an existing chat widget
_meta.status_note: Every value is an ESTIMATE for planning/simulation, not measured data. 'value' is the central (p50) guess; 'low'/'high' a plausible p10-p90 range. Budget/team/cash in idea.md are ASSUMED. Keyword volumes are unknown (no keyword tool data).

weeks_until_first_organic_signups.unit: weeks after first pages go live
weeks_until_first_organic_signups.source: New domain, low-KD long-tail (alternatives for small tools, 'AI onboarding agent', programmatic pages) usually index and get first clicks in 4-10 weeks; Google sandbox for new domains ~8-16 weeks before meaningful traffic (sim/SPEC.md); brand searches after PH launch (W7) may bring earlier 'organic' signups.

organic_visitors_per_month_m3.source: ~36 pages at ~3/week, near-zero domain authority, mostly low-KD long-tail plus brand traffic after Product Hunt; typical new-domain B2B curves are flat for the first 3 months.

organic_visitors_per_month_m6.source: ~75 pages, 15-30 referring domains from directories, study and free tools; alternatives/comparison pages for smaller tools (UserGuiding, Product Fruits, Tandem) start ranking page 1; generator brings low-intent visits.

organic_visitors_per_month_m12.source: ~150 pages incl. programmatic, authority growing log-like; upside depends on the free mascot generator and benchmark earning links; high-KD terms (Intercom alternatives, trial-to-paid) still mostly out of reach.

visitor_to_signup_rate.unit: share of organic visitors who create a free account
visitor_to_signup_rate.source: Blended B2B SaaS site with a free plan: bottom-funnel comparison pages convert ~4-8%, info/blog and generator pages <1%; mix weighted toward info pages early.

signup_to_paid_rate.unit: share of free signups paying within 60 days
signup_to_paid_rate.source: founder/competitors.md planning number 3-5% (First Page Sage 3.7% freemium avg; ChartMogul/ProductLed 2026 median 8% free-to-paid for B2B); panel v2: 2/20 would pay in month 1, rest 'free plan first'.

cold_outreach_reply_rate.unit: replies / new prospects (3-touch sequence, email + LinkedIn)
cold_outreach_reply_rate.source: Instantly 2026 benchmark avg 3.43%, top quartile 5.5%; lists <50 recipients avg 5.8% vs 2.1% large sends; SMB SaaS outbound 10-18% (Autobound, vendor). Uplift assumed from hyper-personalised Loom/screenshot of the prospect's own signup flow.

reply_to_demo_rate.source: Replies to a personalised 'here is the guide on your app' message are mostly qualified; some replies are 'not now'.

demo_to_paid_rate.source: Panel v2: 2/6 small-SaaS buyers (33%, thin, simulated) would pay month 1 with done-for-you setup + A/B report + refund guarantee; demo on their own app removes the top 'show me on my site' objection.

product_hunt_launch_signups.source: Lenny's Newsletter: average B2B launch 50-300 signups; vendor guide: outside top 10 of the day <20 signups, top 3 ~100-400. Launch planned Tue 2026-12-01.

product_hunt_signup_to_paid_rate.source: PH audience skews to 'AI tool collectors' who keep ~1 tool in 10 (panel P001, P008, P019); below site-wide signup->paid.

geo_citation_referral_visitors_per_month.unit: visitors/month from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, AI Overviews links
geo_citation_referral_visitors_per_month.source: SE Ranking: AI platforms = 0.24% (2025) to 0.32% (2026) of all web traffic, ChatGPT ~75% of it; SaaS-tool research over-indexes (assumed 3-10% of a small B2B SaaS site's traffic) applied to ~1,500 organic visitors at M6, plus citations from comparison pages/benchmark.

geo_citation_share_m6.unit: share of 125 weekly prompt-runs (25 prompts x 5 engines) citing Mascott
geo_citation_share_m6.source: Niche, new category ('AI onboarding guide'); few competitors publish structured comparison tables; depends on directory/'best of' inclusions and G2/Capterra reviews.

geo_referral_visitor_to_signup_rate.source: AI-referred visitors arrive pre-qualified by the answer (often a 'best tool for X' query); commonly reported to convert above organic.

blended_arpa_eur.source: pitch-v2 prices (Starter 19 / Growth 49 / Agency 149); both v2 buyers chose Growth; Van Westendorp v2 acceptable range $9-79.

monthly_churn.unit: share of paying accounts lost per month
monthly_churn.source: Given by the founder brief (~5%/month); refunds under the lift guarantee counted separately.

gross_margin.source: Board target >70%; LLM cost per conversation not yet measured (run /founder-cfo).

max_cash_cac_eur_m1_m3.source: 3-month payback cap = 3 x ARPA x gross margin = 3 x 35 x 0.70 = 74 to 3 x 49 x 0.75 = 110; LTV:CAC 3:1 would allow 163-245 but cash and the M3 rule bind.

guarantee_refund_rate.unit: share of new paid accounts refunded month 1
guarantee_refund_rate.source: Refund if no measured lift in 30 days; small-traffic pilots may fail to reach significance (P010: '100 free conversations may be too few to show a lift').

agency_partner_accounts_by_w12.source: Panel v2 agencies (P005, P013, P014) 0/2-3 buy month 1 but would move with white-label + proof; one agency deal plausible after pilot case studies (W8+).
